reader.notes: Witness g85_bf35_07 MATCHes at 85. After a failed OPEN the INITIATE leaves PAGE-COUNTER at the moved 9 (the 2023 EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE no-action arm); 1985 makes that program non-conforming (INITIATE GR2), so the outcome is not judged.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-150/ini2.cob at --std 85 tests one INITIATE naming two reports on one file (REPORTS ARE R1 R2, CODE clauses). On the first run (runs/ini2-001) CODE "A" was refused with COBOL2713, citing §1985:XIII.3.6.3 SR1. cite.py: OK, 'Literal-1 must be a two-character nonnumeric literal.' That is this edition's own arm working. With CODE "AA"/"BB" (runs/ini2-002): MOVE 7/8 TO PAGE-COUNTER OF R1/R2, then INITIATE R1 R2, printed P1 000001 P2 000001. After TERMINATE, MOVE 9 and ADD 3 printed P1 000009 P2 000004. INITIATE R2 R1 (reverse order) then printed P1 000001 P2 000001. The SOURCE PAGE-COUNTER lines in the file read AA000001 and BB000001. ReportWriter.Initiate sets PageCounter = 1 with no edition read (I read the member). cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.5 GR4  (3.5.5 PAGE-COUNTER Rules)  the text is in GR4.
